items.title: Iron Gate (Antioch)
items.description: The Iron Gate is a sixth-century dam located in the mountains to the east of Antakya in Turkey. It is one of the earliest known arch dams and is the oldest to survive. items.title: Mary Peltola
items.description: Mary Sattler Peltola is a Native American politician and former judge who is a United States senator-elect from Alaska. A member of the Democratic Party, she previously served as the U.S. representative for Alaska's at-large congressional district from 2022 to 2025.
